# Windows runtime notice inputs

Incomplete preparation; do not distribute this as a complete notice set.

The [audit](audit.json) binds 80 carried applications, 6067 payload files and 160 native binaries to source/lock hashes. Original notice/declaration bytes are preserved; referenced full terms do not replace original copyrights. Existing Mac notices remain untouched. Native, frontend and system-prerequisite gaps are explicit in the audit.
